observation: The campus photograph shows the dark four-legged structure in front of the museum. The school history collage separately shows a rounded bell shoulder, a flared lower lip, circumferential bands and a protruding clapper. A resurvey should determine timber section, metal thickness and upper fastening.
school_history: The account names the first office building on the restored campus, opened in 1947 and converted to the school history museum in 2010. Different photographs reproduce the school before the war; those photographs are not controls for this structure.
physical_scale: 依据学校在2021年发出的两幅图。钟亭和校钟的总高与开间按图像比例估算，方亭名义高2.69米。铜钟的内部厚度、不可见的挂件、木构背面及屋面背坡为推测。钟亭建造年份待考。
